items.title: Pinned source and license
items.content: Chen/Chewi/Lu/Zhang arXiv2609.06905v1, perpetual non-exclusive arXiv license. Exact raw remains authoritative; this freeze contains paraphrases/minimal formulas only.

items.title: Phase space and fixed parameters
items.content: Source R^d x R^d, fixed y and reference r. ASTIS finite real inner-product Borel space E, including rank0. No randomized parameter binder or uniform-parameter null set.

items.title: Positive lower curvature
items.content: 0 < alpha, genuine positive scalar; no zero-curvature substitution.

items.title: Curvature order
items.content: alpha <= beta.

items.title: Regularity
items.content: V is C^2 everywhere.

items.title: Both Hessian inequalities
items.content: For all x,v: alpha||v||^2 <= D^2V(x)[v,v] <= beta||v||^2.

items.title: Positive proximal scale
items.content: 0 < eta.

items.title: Upper scale
items.content: beta*eta <=1. Retain all six original analytic binders even where a normalization subproof needs fewer.

items.title: Exact conditional position law
items.content: q_y = volume.tilted(-V(x)-||x-y||^2/(2eta)); normalized exact conditional Gibbs law, not unnormalized density, arbitrary law, or approximate sampler q-hat.

items.title: Actual outer phase law
items.content: nu_eta,y = q_y.prod(stdGaussian E). Position and momentum independent; phase density proportional to exp(-V_y(x)-||p||^2/2). Reference r does not enter nu.

items.title: Harmonic flow
items.content: c=y-eta grad V(r); Phi_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(t)p, -sin(t)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(t)p). Phi_0=id.

items.title: Bounce with vanishing normal
items.content: h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r); bounce reflects momentum, R_0=I. ASTIS total division by zero agrees with identity normal convention.

items.title: Rate and hazard
items.content: rate=sqrt(eta)[<p,h_r(x)>]_+; Lambda_t(z)=integral_0^t rate(Phi_s z)ds.

items.title: Actual clock law
items.content: Independent iid Exp(1), canonical infinite product P; Real.toNNReal coordinate adapter. ASTIS zero-index e_n corresponds to source E_(n+1). P is derived probability, not a supplied arbitrary clock law.

items.title: Threshold wait
items.content: Wait is inf{u>=0: Lambda_u >= E_(n+1)}; empty set gives infinite wait, not an undefined finite value.

items.title: Initialized actual recursion
items.content: Start live at (0,z0), add finite wait then bounce flowed state. Infinite wait stops subsequent records; stopped dummy carries no physical phase.

items.title: Physical interpolation
items.content: Half-open arcs T_n<=t<T_(n+1), local elapsed t-T_n>=0. Last live record with infinite next wait covers every later finite time; do not discard it with stopped dummy.

items.title: Nonaccumulation prerequisite
items.content: Energy/cap/wait comparison and direct iid Exp mean1/SLLN give nonaccumulation; stopped alternative included. This84 does not reprove it or substitute a new global process claim.

items.title: Joint measurable actual version
items.content: Source proves Borel terminal version at pi. Existing actual80/82/83 elaborates joint fixed-parameter/phase/finite-time/clock map and actual live-arc semantics; needed for state-parameter expectation measurability.

items.title: Exceptional convention and initialization
items.content: Source failed terminal-limit convention is zero. ASTIS uncovered-arc fallback z0 differs only on exceptional clock outcomes for each fixed y,r,z0, and retains AE initialization and common AE all finite times for those fixed parameters.

items.title: First-event source estimate
items.content: No-first-event branch is Phi_t z; event probability 1-exp(-Lambda_t z) tends0 as t decreases0. Existing82 supplies actual measurable defect inequality, including infinite wait and zero-threshold null exceptions.

items.title: Actual fixed-state clock expectation producer
items.content: actual83 derives inner measurability/integrability, explicit 2M first-event expectation defect and A_t f(z)->f(z) at ordinary NNReal nhds0 for every fixed y,r,z and bounded continuous real f. Consume actual83 internally, not assume an arbitrary process/convergence premise.

items.title: Literal source test class
items.content: The source uses C_c(R^(2d)); compact support gives a finite global bound. Its DCT paragraph is the real outer L2 consumer.

items.title: Bounded continuous test extension
items.content: ASTIS C_b real-valued extension: Continuous f and any real M>=0 with every z |f(z)|<=M. Bound/continuity define test class, not extra dynamics hypotheses. Includes M=0.

items.title: Pointwise expectation definition
items.content: A_t f(z)=integral_clock f(Z(y,r,z,t,clock)) dP. Pointwise representatives before any L2 equivalence-class operator. Fixed deterministic y,r only.

items.title: Parameterized expectation measurability
items.content: Joint measurability of actual Z and continuous real f gives joint strong measurability; SFinite probability P allows integral_prod_right, so z->A_t f(z) is measurable each finite t. This is a real added consumer of actual joint measurability.

items.title: Base Gibbs mass derived
items.content: Positive Hessian lower bound/C^2 => strong convexity => Gaussian quadratic envelope => integral exp(-V) finite and positive. Existing GibbsAugmentation/StrongConvexGibbsIntegrability derive mu=volume.tilted(-V) probability without assumed minimizer or normalization.

items.title: Preferred exact conditional normalization route
items.content: Apply GaussianConditionalKernel to derived base mu probability, obtain everywhere probability quadratic tilt R_y; tilted_tilted with exp(-V) integrability identifies R_y=q_y. Kernel Markov here means normalized fibers only, not actual phase-process Markov.

items.title: Alternative direct conditional normalization route
items.content: exp(-V-quadratic)<=exp(-V), with joint continuity and eta>0, yields integrability and positive q normalizer; isProbabilityMeasure_tilted then q_y probability. This complete route is OR with preferred route, never additional AND requirement.

items.title: Gaussian normalization
items.content: stdGaussian E probability from finite product of standard real Gaussians and measurable orthonormal-basis transport, valid rank0; covariance identity, no eta scaling in momentum.

items.title: Outer product and clock independence
items.content: nu_y=q_y.prod gamma is probability, clocks independently P if an initialized interpretation is made: nu_y.prod P. Iterated expectation does not license arbitrary correlated phase-clock law.

items.title: Inner integrability is derived
items.content: For every state/time, actual83 bounded-test integrability under true P; not assumed as public premise and not integral_undef zero.

items.title: Expectation absolute bound
items.content: P probability + true integrability + |f|<=M => |A_t f(z)|<=M, hence |A_t f(z)-f(z)|<=2M.

items.title: Squared discrepancy measurability
items.content: g_t(z)=(A_t f(z)-f(z))^2 measurable by expectation measurability, continuous f and real square.

items.title: Finite outer domination
items.content: 0<=g_t(z)<=4M^2; constant 4M^2 integrable under derived probability nu_y. Neither invariance nor Jensen contraction needed for this domination.

items.title: Pointwise squared limit
items.content: Actual83 A_t f(z)->f(z), every fixed state; continuity of subtraction/square yields g_t(z)->0. No almost-sure pathwise convergence is inferred from convergence in probability.

items.title: Outer filter dominated convergence
items.content: Ordinary NNReal nhds0 is countably generated. Measurable g_t, uniform integrable constant and every-state limit imply integral g_t dnu_y ->0 via filter DCT.

items.title: Squared discrepancy outer integrability
items.content: Each g_t integrable under nu_y by measurable bounded domination, making squared L2 discrepancy integral genuine.

items.title: Time and initialization boundary
items.content: All finite times NNReal, nonpunctured nhds0 limit includes0; fixed-state AE initialization gives A_0 f(z)=f(z). No real negative-time, uniform-in-time, positive-time Feller or path continuity conclusion.

items.title: Degenerate cases preserved
items.content: Rank0, M0, zero normal, zero hazard/cap, infinite first/last wait, zero raw thresholds and stopped dummy retain parent semantics. Strictly positive iid Exp thresholds AE; no positive wait/cap assumed for every raw clock.

items.title: Quantifier and correlation boundary
items.content: No uniform-parameter AE set, arbitrary correlated random initialization substitution, random y/reference, or full initialized all-time path law/version-uniqueness theorem. Independent nu_y x P only.

items.title: Invariance and Jensen
items.content: Source invariance+Jensen establish contraction. This84 bounded outer DCT uses only finite actual nu; normalization does not establish invariance. Full contraction stays OPEN.

items.title: L2 representatives/operator
items.content: No well-defined bounded operator on L2 equivalence classes from this real pointwise test map alone; AE-representative preservation and full integrability/contraction require separate work.

items.title: Density and all L2 extension
items.content: Source C_c density plus contraction extends strong continuity to all L2. Candidate closes only bounded representative squared-discrepancy ingredient; not this density argument.

items.title: Global process and semigroup
items.content: Restart/Markov/time-homogeneity/Chapman-Kolmogorov/path reversal/invariance/semigroup/hypocoercivity/full L2 remain OPEN; no inference from bounded L2 limit to any of them.

items.title: Ideal auxiliary kernel and costs
items.content: Existing ideal H_y and exact reference law are distinct from implemented approximate reference sampler; candidate has no sampler production, Algorithm1 query costs, main mixing result, SPHMC or multi-paper composition claim.
